As we all know, we received a deficiency letter from the regulator regarding our pediatric monitoring device, and our written response is due in 30 calendar days. A draft response has been circulated internally, but it hasn't been approved or submitted yet. We need to close those gaps before we can responsibly submit. I'd like to understand where each of you stands on these open items and what additional information you need to finalize the response.
